creators.name: Museverse Labs
creators.role: Small studio of musicians and XR engineers making mixed reality music learning for Meta Quest and Android XR
creators.bio: Museverse Labs builds Museverse, a mixed reality app that connects a real piano or keyboard to a headset and teaches it through overlays on the keys. Its recent demos show whole classical pieces played by ghost hands sitting on the player's own instrument.
creators.why: Turns a real instrument into the screen, so the lesson happens exactly where your fingers will go.
creators.role_zh: 由音乐人和 XR 工程师组成的小型工作室，为 Meta Quest 和 Android XR 制作混合现实音乐学习应用
creators.bio_zh: Museverse Labs 开发了 Museverse：一款把真实钢琴或电子琴连接到头显、通过琴键上的叠加画面来教学的混合现实应用。工作室最近的演示里，一双“幽灵手”坐在玩家自己的琴上，完整弹奏古典曲目。
creators.why_zh: 把真实乐器本身变成屏幕，教学正好发生在手指要落下的位置。

creators.name: brenpoly
creators.role: Maker and YouTuber building open-source DIY hardware with local AI
creators.bio: brenpoly builds playful open-source gadgets on YouTube, from a Raspberry Pi BMO agent to an offline virtual pet that gets sick when you doomscroll. His CardboardXR headset turns an old phone and a 3D-printed viewer into a hand-tracked mixed reality device.
creators.why: Shows that a 3-year-old phone, a printer and local AI already add up to a working spatial computer anyone can build.
creators.role_zh: 创客兼 YouTube 博主，用本地 AI 制作开源 DIY 硬件
creators.bio_zh: brenpoly 在 YouTube 上制作好玩的开源小装置：从基于树莓派的 BMO 智能体，到你刷手机太久就会生病的离线电子宠物。他的 CardboardXR 头显用一部旧手机加一个 3D 打印的观看器，做成了能识别手势的混合现实设备。
creators.why_zh: 证明一部三年前的手机、一台打印机和本地 AI，已经足够拼出一台人人都能做的空间计算设备。

creators.name: robomex
creators.role: Augmented reality and computer vision engineer building open-source demos for Apple platforms
creators.bio: robomex engineers AR, computer vision and spatial AI products for Apple platforms and publishes open-source visionOS demos and write-ups on vision.engineer, from object-tracked recipes to a live holographic 3D map of a home. Being legally blind, he tests whether Vision Pro can act as a pair of eyes.
creators.why: Uses each new Apple tracking API to ask a practical question about seeing, with code anyone can rerun.
creators.role_zh: 增强现实与计算机视觉工程师，为 Apple 平台制作开源演示
creators.bio_zh: robomex 为 Apple 平台开发 AR、计算机视觉和空间 AI 产品，并在 vision.engineer 上发布开源的 visionOS 演示和技术文章，从靠物体追踪引导的菜谱应用，到整栋房子的实时全息 3D 地图。作为法定盲人，他在测试 Vision Pro 能否替人“看见”。
creators.why_zh: 每当 Apple 推出新的追踪接口，他都借此追问一个关于“看见”的实际问题，并公开代码让任何人复现。

creators.name: AE.T.HE.R
creators.role: YouTube creator building a voice-driven AI companion that lives in his room on Meta Quest 3
creators.bio: AE.T.HE.R documents, episode by episode, how he builds mixed reality projects without writing code himself, by talking to coding agents: an AI companion that restyles his bedroom, a PS2 fighting game moved onto his floor, and a room assistant that can see. His videos are frank about cost, tokens and every failure.
creators.why: Shows what a non-programmer can now make in mixed reality with coding agents, and is honest about where it breaks.
creators.role_zh: YouTube 创作者，在 Meta Quest 3 上打造一个住在自己房间里、靠语音驱动的 AI 伙伴
creators.bio_zh: AE.T.HE.R 一集一集地记录自己如何不亲手写代码、只靠和编程智能体对话来做混合现实项目：会改造卧室风格的 AI 伙伴、被搬到自家地板上的 PS2 格斗游戏，以及一个能“看见”房间的助手。他的视频坦率交代花费、token 用量和每一次失败。
creators.why_zh: 展示了不会编程的人如今借助编程智能体能在混合现实里做到什么，也坦白了它在哪里会出问题。

works.title: Ghost hands on a real piano
works.description: Through Meta Quest passthrough, translucent ghost hands play the whole of Chopin's Nocturne No. 20 on the player's own piano, with falling notes leading every key and the score scrolling above. From time to time a real hand slips inside the ghost hands and follows them, the way you would practise.
works.description_zh: 透过 Meta Quest 的透视画面，一双半透明的“幽灵手”在玩家自己的钢琴上完整弹奏肖邦第 20 号夜曲，下落的音符引向每一个琴键，乐谱在上方滚动。不时有一只真实的手伸进幽灵手里，跟着它弹，就像练琴时那样。
works.idea_en: Learn by putting your hands inside a master's hands, on your own instrument.
works.idea_zh: 把自己的手放进大师的手里学琴，而且就在你自己的乐器上。
works.technique: The keyboard is registered in passthrough (calibrated to the real keys), and recorded hand poses and MIDI timing drive animated hand meshes and falling-note bars aligned with each key; the app runs in the Quest browser via VIVERSE.
works.technique_zh: 先在透视画面中把键盘与真实琴键校准对齐，再用录制的手部姿态和 MIDI 时间信息驱动动画手部模型，以及与每个琴键对齐的下落音符条；应用通过 VIVERSE 在 Quest 浏览器中运行。
works.exercise_en: Lay a paper keyboard (or a real one) on a table, align a WebXR or phone-AR overlay to it with two tapped corners, and play back a recorded MIDI melody as glowing fingertips landing on the right keys. Twist: record your own hands with hand tracking and play them back as ghosts for a classmate to follow.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌上铺一张纸质键盘（或真实键盘），点两个角把 WebXR 或手机 AR 叠加层与它对齐，然后把录好的 MIDI 旋律回放成落在正确琴键上的发光指尖。变体：用手部追踪录下你自己的双手，回放成幽灵手，让同学跟着弹。

works.title: CardboardXR: a $5 Apple Vision Pro
works.description: A 3D-printed viewer with $5 Cardboard lenses turns a 3-year-old iPhone or Pixel into a mixed reality headset with room tracking, hand tracking from local AI, plane detection, an AR portal, an orb-catching game and air painting. The video went viral with over half a million views, and the Unity project and print files are open source.
works.description_zh: 一个 3D 打印的观看器，配上 5 美元的 Cardboard 透镜，就把一部三年前的 iPhone 或 Pixel 变成了混合现实头显：有房间追踪、由本地 AI 实现的手部追踪、平面检测、AR 传送门、接光球小游戏和空中绘画。视频播放量超过五十万，Unity 工程和打印文件都已开源。
works.idea_en: The phone in your pocket already holds everything a spatial computer needs; it only needs a cheap face to wear it.
works.idea_zh: 口袋里的手机早已具备空间计算设备所需的一切，只差一个便宜的“面罩”把它戴上。
works.technique: ARKit/ARCore SLAM and LiDAR give 6DoF tracking and plane detection, MediaPipe hand landmarks run on the phone's NPU through Unity's Inference Engine for gaze-and-pinch input, a custom stereo rig uses Cardboard's barrel-distortion math at up to 120 Hz, and a thermal governor lowers AI and frame rates before the phone throttles.
works.technique_zh: ARKit/ARCore 的 SLAM 和 LiDAR 提供六自由度追踪与平面检测；MediaPipe 手部关键点通过 Unity Inference Engine 在手机 NPU 上运行，实现“注视 + 捏合”输入；自制的双目相机组件使用 Cardboard 的桶形畸变参数，最高 120 Hz 渲染；温控调节器会在手机降频之前主动降低 AI 推理频率和帧率。
works.exercise_en: Put a phone in a cardboard or printed viewer, render an AR Foundation scene in side-by-side stereo with passthrough, and add one hand-tracked interaction (pinch to grab a cube on the real table). Twist: design an experience that only works because it is cheap, for example one headset per student for a shared classroom scene.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机装进纸板或 3D 打印的观看器，用 AR Foundation 以左右分屏立体方式渲染带透视的场景，再加入一个手部追踪交互（捏合抓起真实桌面上的一个方块）。变体：设计一个正因为便宜才成立的体验，比如每个学生一台头显，共享同一个课堂场景。

works.title: Can I perform tasks blind? (visionOS 27 object tracking)
works.description: A sighted helper with an iPhone places three meal courses on a table and sets where each one goes; the Apple Vision Pro wearer, eyes closed, is then guided by sound alone to pick up each real carton and put it in the right spot. Both devices first look at the same tracked object, which gives them a shared map of the space; the code is open source.
works.description_zh: 拿着 iPhone 的明眼帮手把三道菜摆到桌上，并设定每道菜应放的位置；随后，闭着眼的 Apple Vision Pro 佩戴者只靠声音引导，拿起每个真实的盒子并放到正确的位置。两台设备先看向同一个被追踪的物体，以此获得共同的空间坐标。代码开源。
works.idea_en: A legally blind developer asks whether a headset can be his eyes, and splits the job: a helper sets the goal, sound does the guiding.
works.idea_zh: 一位法定盲人开发者追问头显能否成为自己的眼睛，并把任务一分为二：帮手设定目标，声音负责引导。
works.technique: Real food packages are trained as Create ML reference objects and tracked with ARKit object tracking on both iOS 27 (60 fps) and visionOS 27; a commonly tracked object aligns the two devices' coordinate frames, and RealityKit spatial audio cues steer the hand toward each target placement.
works.technique_zh: 用 Create ML 把真实的食品包装训练成参考物体，并在 iOS 27（60 fps）和 visionOS 27 上用 ARKit 物体追踪识别；两台设备通过同一个被追踪的物体对齐坐标系，再由 RealityKit 的空间音频提示把手引向每个目标位置。
works.exercise_en: With phone AR, let one student tap three target spots on a table, then have a blindfolded partner wearing headphones place three real objects using only a beeping sound whose pitch and pan follow the distance to the target (track the hand with MediaPipe or the object with an image marker). Twist: replace the beeps with spoken directions from a language model and compare speed and stress.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR，让一名同学在桌面上点出三个目标位置，再让戴着耳机、蒙着眼的搭档仅凭“嘀嘀”声把三个真实物体放到位：音高和左右声道随与目标的距离变化（用 MediaPipe 追踪手，或用图像标记追踪物体）。变体：把提示音换成语言模型给出的口头指令，比较速度和紧张程度。

works.title: I Gave My Room an AI That Can See
works.description: A voice companion lives in the creator's bedroom on Meta Quest 3: asked about Apple's stock, she builds the chart out of particles in mid-air and, when he points at a day, explains what was reported that week; asked what a reading nook would look like in the corner, she sketches two, turns one into a 3D model on his own GPU, and says it will not fit because of his bed, curtain and cables, before he throws it across the room.
works.description_zh: 一个语音伙伴住进了创作者的卧室（Meta Quest 3）：问她苹果公司的股价，她就在半空中用粒子搭出走势图；指向其中某一天，她会讲出那一周的新闻报道。问她房间角落做个阅读角会是什么样，她画了两个方案，把其中一个在他自己的显卡上生成 3D 模型，然后指出因为床、窗帘和一团电线，这个角落放不下，接着他把模型扔到了房间另一头。
works.idea_en: An assistant that answers by building things in your room, and can also tell you when your room says no.
works.idea_zh: 一个用“在你房间里搭东西”来回答问题的助手，它也会告诉你：你的房间不同意。
works.technique: Unity 6.3 with the Meta XR SDK over Link, the OpenAI Realtime API for voice and tool calls, passthrough frames sent to a vision model to read the room, and a fully local text-to-image, cut-out and image-to-3D chain on an RTX 5080 that returns a mesh in about 3–4 seconds; built entirely by prompting Claude Code and Codex.
works.technique_zh: 基于 Unity 6.3 和 Meta XR SDK，通过 Link 连接电脑；语音和工具调用用 OpenAI Realtime API；把透视画面发给视觉模型来理解房间；在 RTX 5080 上本地完成“文字生成图像、抠图、图像生成 3D”的流程，约 3–4 秒得到一个网格模型。整个项目完全靠向 Claude Code 和 Codex 下指令完成。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone AR assistant that answers one kind of question only by placing an object: for 'how tall is a giraffe?' it stands a scaled giraffe in the room, for 'will a sofa fit here?' it drops a box of real sofa size on the detected floor and reports collisions. Twist: make it refuse politely and explain which real object is in the way.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机 AR 助手，它对某一类问题只用“放一个东西”来回答：问“长颈鹿有多高？”就在房间里立起一只按比例的长颈鹿；问“这里放得下沙发吗？”就在识别出的地面上放一个真实沙发大小的盒子，并报告碰撞。变体：让它礼貌地拒绝，并说明是哪件真实物体挡了路。

leads.name: Natasha Gubernov — ArtGuide
leads.why: Spectacles Community Challenge #16 (New Lens, 2nd): projects composition guides, reference images, AI feedback and on-demand 3D still lifes onto the artist's real paper or canvas. Lenslist spotlight 2026-11-04. No public video found; try her X or LinkedIn.

leads.name: Shahwali Shayan — Plane Spotter
leads.why: Spectacles Community Challenge #16 (New Lens, 1st): Heathrow Airport as a live tabletop model driven by real flight data, with tappable aircraft cards. No public video found.

leads.name: Baruch Geuze — OpenBand
leads.why: Spectacles Community Challenge #16 (Open Source, 1st): control Spectacles from a smartwatch with pinch and forearm gestures plus haptic feedback. Repo public; no video found (GitHub API blocked during this round).

leads.name: Elsa Farrokhzadeh (urbanpeppermint) — Spatial AI DJ
leads.why: Spectacles Community Challenge #16 (Open Source, 3rd): an AI-generated mix you shape by dragging pucks across four decks in 3D space. Has a YouTube channel (@urbanpeppermint) but no video of this Lens yet.

leads.name: Tim Van Leemput — ParaKo
leads.why: Meta VR Start 2026 entry: a tiny parasite takes root in your hand in mixed reality; feed it, catch flies with a sway of the hand, and it grows gifts that change what your hands can do. Only a 57 s trailer so far (_9iRUYeJVoE); look for gameplay.

leads.name: Abhimanyu R B — Perihelion
leads.why: Meta VR Start 2026 WebXR puzzle: pinch and slingshot a comet, plant gravity wells in the air, or put a real cup on your desk and it bends the comet too. Video (Ds5Jt9tzgnA) appears to be emulator footage; check for a real-desk recording.

leads.name: yi yu — Foldlings
leads.why: Meta VR Start 2026 WebXR origami: fold a virtual sheet with bare hands until it becomes a creature that settles on a real surface in your room. Open source (github.com/yy5652-hash/foldlings), but the video (RX2S5l6ZVmA) mixes web-build captures with Blender renders.

leads.name: Frameless Labs — The Winner Takes It All
leads.why: Work-in-progress mixed reality dance in a park: audience members in Quest 3 at a chess board watch dancers who perform live from Washington State and New York via VRChat. Revisit when the performance is documented (video 3yzdL1l9VJ0 is a short WIP pitch).

leads.name: Hand-shadow MR games (Rohit Purkait — Shadowkin; 최재원 — Shadowfolk; Ankit Hemant Lade — Shadow Zoo; Design Master Solutions — WICK)
leads.why: A cluster of Meta VR Start 2026 WebXR entries where your hand's shadow on a real wall or paper becomes a creature or a solid bridge (Shadowfolk: move the hand toward the lantern and the shadow grows huge and soft). Strong salient idea, but all videos (MZuxKrEJJU8, QFCNsidQnxI, UDuvUWqNC5c, ZQAuG4g5L9g) are IWER-emulator footage; add the best once real-headset video exists. Code: github.com/cjw0076/shadowfolk.

leads.name: AE.T.HE.R — I Gave My AI a Body. Now She Runs My Room
leads.why: Second episode by the same creator: a voice companion restyles his real bedroom into The Witcher, Minecraft and Night City live on Quest 3 (W-iOBGWTtpY). Consider as a restyle work if the room-replacement holds up on viewing.
